name: v1.6.11
body:
## New Features
* Digi: JTTY, the WSJT-X 3.2 asynchronous text mode. It searches 1200-1800 Hz plus the operator's own frequency, logs one line per message and says why a TX was refused, by @madmedicnl in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/597
* Translations: the interface is available in Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Dutch, Russian, Turkish, Chinese and Japanese, with bundled fonts for Chinese and Japanese. Pick the language in Settings > UI
* 3D view: the date is shown beside the UTC and local clocks (#686)
* SSTV: ten transmit image slots, laid out in two rows (#753)
* Memories: CLEAR deletes every memory channel at once (#755)


## Other Changes
* Wavelog: upload QSOs, sync the logbook and report radio status directly by @joscandreu in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/666
* TX Audio chain for Mic by @joscandreu in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/700
* Sstv image upload to FTP by @joscandreu in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/701
* BUG FIX: AGC and BW filters not properly propagated to the ICOM radios by @joscandreu in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/712
* Add a Hardrock amplifier panel and ELAD FDM-DUO power controls by @AJ3G in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/717
* SmartSDR: settle the DAX IQ rate on the radio's packets, not the requ… by @NosDE in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/721
* Add an outbound TCI client that follows the dial by @kingsqueak in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/725
* Bug fix: Text not being sent over SSTV by @joscandreu in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/757
* SmartSDR: built-in ATU control, an SWR bar in the tune box, and SWR/power meter fixes by @NosDE in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/728
* Fix JS8 heartbeat acknowledgements for received compound frames by @erikdewildt in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/730
* Record completed JS8 transmissions in conversation history by @erikdewildt in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/731
* FT8: decode as the slot arrives, Deep at WSJT-X's checkpoints (mfsk-core 0.14) by @joscandreu in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/737
* Implemented the option to accept self-signed certificates for wss by @joscandreu in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/739
* PlutoSDR: LO power on open and between overs, no false disconnect after an over by @slomkowski in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/747
* Digi: pad a short receive period before decoding it by @slomkowski in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/748
* Satellites: QO-100 NB transponder spans the full 500 kHz, beacons per AMSAT-DL by @slomkowski in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/749
* Band plan: optional label for a sub-segment by @slomkowski in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/750
* Implement translations via fluent by @joscandreu in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/742

## Bug Fixes
* Audio: reopen a microphone whose stream the host broke, so an IC-705 transmits again (#707)
* CW: a PTT release ends a keyed over in the keyer instead of leaving it latched, fixing CW keying and PTT state with a MIDI keyer (#716)
* Engine: the rig's drive report is no longer adopted while keyed, so TUNE stops overwriting the Drive setting (#741)
* SDRplay: empty the receive ring at unkey, so the end of every over is no longer replayed as receive (e.g. in FT8) (#697)
* Hermes Lite 2 IO board: tell it the dial frequency on open and resend a lost receive-input write, fixing transverter and drive issues (#444)
* T/R switch: pace LCUS relay frames and restate the band word while off air, so BCD band patterns work on USB serial relay modules (#627)
* Satellites: a 1k2 AFSK link is now tuned in APRS mode rather than USB on CAT rigs (#651)
* Globe: mouse-wheel zoom works straight away instead of waiting for a VIEW focus chip to be clicked (#702)
* Public SDRs: a search without a literal match now falls back only to close fuzzy matches instead of listing unrelated receivers (#756)
* SmartSDR: clear the radio's own-TX flag on reconnect
* Remote TLS: hand-edited certificate pins are normalised, and the openssl hint is shown as plain text
* Follow-up fixes to new features in this release: the TCI client no longer blocks on shutdown and limits how long it drains reads; Icom AGC is skipped in FM; the Wavelog download stops at an empty page; ELAD/Hardrock drive is scaled correctly on the USB gateway and amp band changes wait until off air; TX audio presets keep the limiter

## New Contributors
* @AJ3G made their first contribution in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/717
* @NosDE made their first contribution in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/721
* @kingsqueak made their first contribution in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/725
* @erikdewildt made their first contribution in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/730
* @slomkowski made their first contribution in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/747

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/compare/v1.6.10...v1.6.11

name: v1.6.10
body: ## Highlights ### Satellite passes at a glance The satellite window has a new **PASSES** tab: every pass of every workable satellite over the next 24 or 48 hours, soonest first. Each row shows when it rises (UTC and your local time), how long until then, how long it lasts, how high it peaks and which way it rises and sets. **PEAK** hides the low passes, and a click on a row picks that satellite, with its pass diagram, links and lock. Pass times everywhere in the window now carry your local time beside UTC. (#623, #635) ### FT8 decodes as they are found FT8 has a selectable decode depth (**Fast**, **Normal**, **Deep**) and runs the checkpointed signal subtraction WSJT-X uses, which digs out weak stations hidden under strong ones. The quick pass is shown at once, so an auto-sequenced reply is never held up, and each further decode from the subtraction pass now appears the moment it is found instead of all together at the end. A PC too slow to finish a Deep pass before the next slot skips the slow pass rather than falling further and further behind. (#667) ### Olivia talks to fldigi and MultiPSK Olivia used a scrambler and interleaver of its own, so it could not decode any other station. It now follows fldigi's reference design bit for bit, and has been checked against fldigi's own encoder and decoder in both directions. (#621) ### Receive gain per band, S-meter calibration, audio per ear Three new rows in **Settings > Radio**: - **Gain per band**: each band gets back the receive gain you last set on it, however the dial got there. General coverage is split into HF, VHF, UHF and above, so an RTL-SDR can sit at 10 dB on shortwave and 40 dB on 2 m without touching it. (#605) - **S-meter calibration**: an SDR's meter reads dBFS until it is told where zero is, which is why a sensitive dongle shows S9 with no antenna. Set the offset here and watch the meter move as you drag. (#642) - **Audio to**: this radio's audio on both channels, the left only or the right only - two radios on one headset, one in each ear. The station-wide **Channels** setting under General does the same for everything you hear. (#654) ### Morse trainer and grid tracker SDROxide now features a **Morse trainer** with a reference chart, a practice player and a Koch drill A **grid tracker** shows the Maidenhead squares you have worked on a map. ### PSTRotator The antenna rotator can now be driven through **PSTRotator** over its UDP control port, as well as through Hamlib rotctld. Choose it under **Program** in Settings > Servers and turn on UDP Control in PSTRotator's Setup. (#638) ### Split view with many radios With more radios than fit across half a window, split view showed only the tab strip and nothing below it. Tabs now wrap onto a second row whole, and every pane draws its radio. (#653) ### Upgrading a client/server station The remote protocol version moves from 175 to 179 (new per-radio settings and the rotator's program choice). Update the server and every native remote client together; the browser client is served by the server and updates with it. ## What's Changed - **FSK441**: transmit - the message repeats for the length of the over by @madmedicnl in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/561 - **FSK441**: the refusal reason is stored last, the TX row is pinned under the decode list, and stale docs are updated - **Morse trainer**: a reference chart, a practice player and a Koch drill by @madmedicnl in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/568 - **Morse trainer**: plays at the device rate on the alert output, stops when closed, shares progress across tabs, and will not start a drill with no sound device - **CW**: key as audio through the sound card when there is no control link to key as text by @madmedicnl in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/572 - **CW**: PTT holds the transmitter for the keyer with no carrier of its own, and the key or the keyer sends inside it; a MIDI key note no longer drops a held PTT, and a mapped note keys the straight key (#625) - **Keyboard modes**: editable message buttons for PSK, RTTY, Olivia and THOR by @madmedicnl in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/596 - **Keyboard modes**: the button row's height is budgeted, and F1 stays the manual's (the buttons are on F2-F10) - **Olivia**: fldigi's scrambler, interleaver, Walsh code and symbol shaping, so real Olivia stations decode and are decoded; the receiver searches about four tones either side of the dial (#621) - **Grid tracker**: worked Maidenhead squares on a map by @madmedicnl in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/613 - **Grid tracker**: every band is tallied, the awards share one grid parser, and heard squares are counted while the layer is off - **FT8**: selectable decode depth (Fast / Normal / Deep) by @madmedicnl in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/604 - **FT8**: run the checkpointed signal subtraction, like FT4 and WSJT-X by @madmedicnl in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/586 - **FT8**: decodes stream in as they are found, slots arriving late are placed under their own slot in the list, and a slow pass is skipped when the next slot is already waiting (#667) - **NAVTEX**: track the tuning error instead of decoding it by @madmedicnl in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/611 - **LimeSDR Mini**: offer lower TX rates, which clear its underruns, by @madmedicnl in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/612; the low rates are added to the full list rather than replacing it - **Recording**: split on silence, so an airband monitor gets a file per transmission by @madmedicnl in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/557 - **Recording**: quick clips disarm the gate, and it idles while the squelch is open - **SSTV**: improved sensitivity by @joscandreu in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/587 - **SSTV**: a counter underflow fixed, the second pass bounded on weak pictures, and a stale AFC offset dropped - **Satellites**: the ISS SSTV downlink on 437.550 MHz, and SSTV links tune in SSTV-FM (#622) - **Satellites**: a PASSES tab listing every upcoming pass, soonest first (#623), and pass times shown in local time beside UTC (#635) - **rigctl**: a new width in the mode already running sets the filter by @AJ6CU in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/631 - **rigctl**: squelch, AGC and NR strength as Hamlib levels by @AJ6CU in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/632 - **rigctl**: the RF level, as the front-end RX gain by @AJ6CU in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/633 - **rigctl**: SQL drives a radio's own squelch, non-finite levels are refused, AGC LONG/ON are mapped, and the width actually applied is compared - **Decoded CW over UDP**: the CW panel's settled copy as plain text, for other programs, by @AJ6CU in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/634 - **Decoded CW over UDP**: a word gap is kept across CLEAR RX and the sender's address is matched - **eQSL**: send the QTH nickname on upload, test and download by @madmedicnl in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/648 (#647) - **Icom**: receive-mode fallback, and HD Radio offered only when the panadapter can carry it, by @K7MDL2 in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/650 (#649) - **Icom**: a paired panadapter takes the modes the control rig refuses - **Icom IC-7851 and other LAN rigs**: an RTTY view no longer walks the dial up the band, and a radio that has not reported its frequency yet is no longer sent to 30 kHz (#576) - **Icom LAN**: ALC and power meters are read while transmitting (#600) - **Clock**: UTC and local time together in the UI by @madmedicnl in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/660 (#655); shown in every mode, with a setting to hide it, and it steps aside for the pointer - **Audio**: output routing - left, right or both - for everything you hear by @madmedicnl in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/661 (#654), folding to mono on the chosen side - **Audio**: a per-radio **Audio to** setting in Settings > Radio, for two radios in two ears (#654) - **HFDL**: the operator's own frequency chips by @madmedicnl in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/663 (#617) - **HFDL**: the rig is put in USB rather than FM, and a USB report no longer throws the app out of HFDL (#662) - **Gain per band**: receive gain is remembered per band and restored as the dial returns (#605) - **S-meter**: a per-radio calibration in Settings > Radio, applied live (#642) - **Spectrum**: setting the floor or ceiling by hand switches FIT off, so the level stays where it was put (#642) - **Window title**: shows the version (#664) - **Split view**: tabs that do not fit wrap onto the next row whole, so the panes no longer go black (#653) - **Rotator**: PSTRotator over its UDP control port (#638) - **Panadapter pairing**: the S-meter follows the attached receiver unless the transceiver's audio is the one heard (#619) - **Panadapter pairing**: the transmit monitor appears at key-down instead of seconds later (#618) - **Panadapter pairing**: a receiver lent at runtime leaves the tab strip without a restart (#620) - **Panadapter pairing**: an I.F. tap parks the receiver on the rig's fixed I.F. and tunes the rig, as on a K3 with a KXV3B (#577) - **Panadapter pairing**: a borrowed RSPduo's diversity filter is driven and saved from the borrowing radio's DIV box (#637) - **Engine**: external RX audio and the wide view keep running when there is no audio output (#640) - **Full duplex**: the received spectrum and waterfall keep drawing through an over, so a QO-100 station sees its own downlink (#652) - **AIS**: a decimated zero-IF front end such as an RSPdx no longer pushes AIS A out of the window (#658) - **FreeDV (RADE)**: microphone audio after release no longer piles up into the next over and the "samples dropped" warning (#614) - **WSPR**: transmit duty, power and band hopping are kept per radio (#615) - **HPSDR**: a Hermes-Lite 2 on Hermes-emulation gateware is recognised, so its PA is switched on (#578) - **HPSDR Protocol 2**: transmit I/Q is sent at the stream's own rate instead of in bursts, for choppy SSB on a Brick2 (#659) - **Globe and map**: the home marker and its arcs meet from any angle, and the decode map recovers from a broken view (#656) - **Remote**: a reconnecting tab keeps its radio's address (#646) - **ISM**: the window uses a clock that works in the browser, which froze the server's web UI (#601) - **Logging**: the "TX refused" warning names the radio and mode (#566) ## Documentation - The manual covers the FT8 decode depth and the streamed decodes, NAVTEX tuning tolerance, the LimeSDR Mini's low rates, and CW keying through the sound card when there is no control link - The manual covers the PASSES tab, the new Settings > Radio rows (Audio to, Gain per band, S-meter calibration) and how Audio to combines with the station's Channels, PSTRotator, the I.F. tap, Full duplex on the panadapter, PTT in CW with a MIDI keyer, and the version in the title bar ## New Contributors * @joscandreu made their first contribution in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/587 * @AJ6CU made their first contribution in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/631 * @K7MDL2 made their first contribution in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/650 **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/compare/v1.6.9...v1.6.10

name: v1.6.9
body:
## What's Changed
* Web client: install to a home screen as a full-screen app, and keep the screen awake by @dielectric-coder in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/490
* NAVTEX: show the time of day a message states by @madmedicnl in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/492
* (tr)uSDX: a CAT family with the audio path the operator chooses by @madmedicnl in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/498
* Icom: WFM is its own CI-V mode byte, not narrow FM (#494) by @madmedicnl in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/501
* RADE: report an unidentified reception, and show the heard callsign by @madmedicnl in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/503
* SSTV: give the picture's text a look by @madmedicnl in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/505
* Keep the hardware LO off the VFO when the panadapter centres on it, so AM does not distort under CTR by @dielectric-coder in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/523
* CW: a local sidetone, a read-back for the straight key, and the fixes that fell out (#495) by @madmedicnl in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/507
* HD Radio: wire up the AM-band variant (HD on AM) (#489) by @madmedicnl in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/514
* Add a PI4 (Next Generation Beacon) decoder by @sq6emm in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/528
* Web mic: an idle radio tab must not drain the microphone ring (#493) by @madmedicnl in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/529
* HFDL: say when decoding is off, and let the dial follow the channel by @madmedicnl in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/524
* Stop borders and rivers streaking across a panned whole-world map by @dielectric-coder in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/531
* Add an auto-stop timer to the on-air MP3 recorder (#520) by @madmedicnl in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/532
* Let CTR centre an FM HD Radio station, which the LO guard held 400 kHz off by @dielectric-coder in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/534
* Keep the dial centred when the panadapter is zoomed with CTR lit by @dielectric-coder in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/538
* Relay: band-decoder outputs for external filters and transverters (#442) by @sq6emm in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/530
* Correct two SDRplay binding comments that state things the API specification does not say about HDR by @dielectric-coder in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/539
* Put the HFDL panel's status slots on one row by @dielectric-coder in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/540
* FST4: the slow weak-signal mode, receive only by @madmedicnl in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/551
* Q65: the modern weak-signal mode, receive only by @madmedicnl in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/552
* FT2: subtract decoded signals so a masked weak one still decodes by @madmedicnl in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/563
* JS8: subtract decoded frames so a masked weak one still decodes by @madmedicnl in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/564
* Map: shade the night side and the twilight on the flat maps by @madmedicnl in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/541
* BANDS: a meteor-shower calendar, radiants placed for the station by @madmedicnl in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/542
* BANDS: the IBP beacon schedule, with bearing and distance by @madmedicnl in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/543
* AURORA: show the observed Kp history beside the forecast by @madmedicnl in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/544
* MSK144: the meteor-scatter mode, receive only by @madmedicnl in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/549
* JT65/JT9: the two weak-signal slotted modes, receive only by @madmedicnl in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/550
* FSK441: the original meteor-scatter mode, receive only by @madmedicnl in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/555
* VDL2: derive the window rate from the device, so a 768 kSPS HF+ holds the plan by @madmedicnl in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/556
* FT4: subtract decoded signals so a masked weak one still decodes by @madmedicnl in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/562
* Decode: a SAVE chip on every text panel, so decoded text can be kept by @madmedicnl in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/558
* Add Hermes-Lite 2 SWR telemetry for Protocol 1 by @DG4MD-sketch in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/570
* Band/mode selector: dock it beside the waterfall by @madmedicnl in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/575
* Feed this station's own decodes into the propagation field by @madmedicnl in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/579
* Remember the 3D window's size and place across a rebuild by @madmedicnl in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/580
* digital: a hand-picked sign-off is not undone by the DX repeating by @madmedicnl in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/583
* CAT/Audio IQ: probe the opened PCM's own stream, so a stereo I/Q input is not called mono by @madmedicnl in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/588
* REC: a Quick clip row — 30 s or 1 min in one press by @madmedicnl in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/590
* Alerts: a spoken reply, so a new DX can be heard and not only rung by @madmedicnl in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/591
* Grey line: shade the continents too, and stronger by @madmedicnl in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/593

## New Contributors
* @sq6emm made their first contribution in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/528
* @DG4MD-sketch made their first contribution in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/570

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/compare/v1.6.8...v1.6.9

name: v1.6.8
body:
## What's Changed
- **HD Radio (NRSC-5)**: a new receive mode for the digital sidecar of FM broadcasts - HDC audio in stereo, the HD-2 subchannels, and the station's name, slogan and message, decoded by the vendored nrsc5 receiver by @madmedicnl in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/466 (#437)
- **HD Radio**: the decoder runs on a thread of its own, goes back to HD-1 on a retune, lights AUDIO only on frames that carry sound, and says which rate it needs instead of starting on a channel too narrow for the digital sidebands (#437)
- **HD Radio**: a bench example decodes a recorded capture, including one whose rate is not a whole multiple of the decoder's, by @dielectric-coder in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/481
- ** HD Radio**: The decoder is now loaded at runtime (#488)
- **ACARS**: a new receive mode for the airline datalink on VHF airband - 2400-baud MSK over AM, with each message's time, aircraft registration, label, acknowledgement, block and text listed newest first, and chips for the ACARS channels by @madmedicnl in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/465 (#436)
- **ACARS**: tuned with the carrier on the dial, as for AM voice, and a CAT rig is put in AM rather than the digital modes' sideband; bursts the carrier loop locked upside down and blocks with no text decode too, only messages that pass their block check are listed, a damaged block is counted once, and the European 131.525 and 131.825 MHz join the channel chips. The demodulator and block check are ported from acarsdec (#436)
- **USB audio radio**: a new interface for radios with no control port - VOX-keyed handhelds, walkie-talkies, audio dongles - with receive audio from one sound card, transmit audio into another and the dial as a label by @madmedicnl in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/456
- **USB audio radio**: give back both sound cards before a reconnect opens the replacement, as CAT/Audio does (#15)
- **CW**: the PC keyboard as a straight key - **KEY** makes the Space bar the key on the radio that holds the keyboard, ahead of any shortcut bound to Space and with a 30-second hold cap, and the key is lifted on a tab switch, when the window loses focus and when a remote client drops by @madmedicnl in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/453 (#322)
- **Audible alerts**: a new Alerts settings tab rings on its own sound device for a station calling you, a CQ you could answer, a new DXCC entity, a new entity on this band or a new grid - one alarm per batch of decodes, for the most important match, with a quiet period per station, and one alarm shared by every radio tab by @madmedicnl in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/457
- **Profiles**: save how the station is set up - dials and VFOs, modes, levels, gains, antennas, the digital identity and message templates, and the band stacks - under a name, and put it back in one click; the hardware is left out, remote and browser clients share the same list, and an apply is refused while the radio is on the air by @madmedicnl in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/454 (#197)
- **Per-mode settings**: AGC, squelch, noise reduction, the auto-notch and the stereo switches are remembered per mode - each mode starts from conservative values of its own (slow AGC on the weak-signal digital modes, noise reduction and the auto-notch off), a change made while a mode is selected is kept for that mode, and a **DEFAULTS** chip beside the controls puts the mode's own values back, by @madmedicnl in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/485
- **Per-mode settings**: the mode's values are applied at startup and when the rig's own controls change the mode, a restored session's levels and a profile's are kept as that mode's own, and `modeprofiles.json` leaves unset values out and is saved when the connection to the engine drops, so the last change is not lost
- **Decodes**: export the decode list as CSV and as received-report ADIF, each record marked SWL and placed on the dial it was heard on by @madmedicnl in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/450 (#433)
- **Logbook**: an ADIF import leaves out records marked SWL and says how many, so the decode export never lands in the log as contacts (#433)
- **Web client**: import ADIF and CHIRP files in the browser by @madmedicnl in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/452 (#445)
- **Web client**: the microphone reaches the transmitter again - the mic worklet is now connected so the browser renders it by @madmedicnl in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/476 (#468)
- **Themes**: ten more colour themes - Nord, Nord dark, Gruvbox, Everforest, Solarized, Solarized dark, Dracula, Catppuccin Mocha, Catppuccin Latte and Modern minimalist - by @madmedicnl in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/455, with the faintest accents lifted to a readable contrast
- **Tuning**: an opt-in **First press** on the step row rounds the dial onto the step before it moves by @madmedicnl in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/451 (#422)
- **Tuning buttons**: snap to the step's own grid in the direction pressed, so a 100 Hz or 500 Hz step no longer rounds back to where it was and a 2.5 kHz step no longer walks backwards (#422, #431)
- **SSTV**: decode the PD family and Wraase SC-2, say so when a header names a mode sdroxide cannot draw, and give Martin back the separator its line was missing (#421)
- **AIS**: zoom, pan and FIT controls on the vessel chart by @madmedicnl in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/461 (#459)
- **AIS**: vessel names are placed by priority instead of all vanishing once more than 30 vessels are in view - the selected vessel, the one under the pointer and any in distress always keep theirs, then SOLAS ships, other craft and last the marks, each only where it misses the names already on the chart, by @madmedicnl in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/486 (#408)
- **AIS**: a name at the edge of the chart moves to another corner of its symbol instead of going missing, names keep off other vessels' symbols and the station's own mark, and two names that must show keep off each other in a crowded harbour (#408)
- **ADS-B**: data blocks are placed the same way instead of all being dropped once more than 25 aircraft are in view - aircraft on the ground give way first, and the selected target, the one under the pointer and any squawking an emergency always keep theirs
- **WEFAX**: the phase nudge also corrects the part of the chart already received by @madmedicnl in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/464 (#439)
- **JS8**: the template chips write into the compose box and SEND is the one way out, a typed CQ goes out as a real CQ frame, and CLEAR TO and CLEAR RX behave alike by @madmedicnl in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/478 (#472, #473)
- **JS8**: AGN? repeats the last message once instead of with the callsign doubled
- **Public SDR**: sdr-list.xyz joins as a third receiver directory, and each receiver says why sdroxide cannot open it yet (#482)
- **HPSDR Protocol 2**: send the open-collector outputs in byte 1401, not 1400, so a filter board switches at all (#438)
- **HPSDR Protocol 2**: the DUC runs at 192 kHz, the Alex words are sent, the two-ADC boards are recognised, and the DUC command declares its DAC (#440)
- **PureSignal**: a meter readout says whether the loop locked and how much it is correcting, instead of only the log (#441)
- **ELAD FDM-DUO**: follow the radio's own VFO knob on the receive cable alone, by reading the tuning back off the streaming interface by @dielectric-coder in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/462
- **ELAD FDM-DUO**: work the radio's own VFO B when sdroxide's is taken up, so its display, its knob and its A/B button are on the dial being worked by @dielectric-coder in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/467; a VFO taken up mid-over now waits for the unkey, and clicking a VFO puts the radio back in step after its own A/B button was pressed
- **VFO A/B**: a rig with two VFOs of its own is told which one first, before the mode recall retunes it, and a converter adds its offset to that selection instead of taking it away
- **SDRplay**: report a front end that keeps overloading once and then once a minute, rather than twice a second by @dielectric-coder in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/475
- **PlutoSDR**: a board whose state machine was left parked in *alert* - every register as configured, the receiver off, one sample value repeated - is put back to receiving on connect; a TDD board sdroxide is not driving, or one whose state machine follows its enable pins, is left alone and says on connect that it is not receiving (#470)
- **PlutoSDR**: closing the radio is no longer logged as the receive socket failing, which made the end of every `probe` run read as `iiod` crashing, and the `probe` example says so when every sample is the same value or they arrive faster than the sample rate (#470)
- **PlutoSDR**: a receive connection that goes silent while the board still answers a fresh one is replaced within a second, instead of after two to eight seconds of dead audio; a board that has itself paused is still waited out, and the session trace records which of the two each stall was (#377, #418)
- **Recording**: shine-rs 0.1.4 fixes the MP3 encoder underflow, and a panic in the encoder no longer ends a recording in silence (#443)
- **DSP**: the complex resampler behind DRM, the neural CW decoder's tuner and HD Radio writes into a buffer it keeps, instead of allocating and moving memory for every chunk at I/Q rates
- **Settings**: the radio's sound card and its receive gain move to the Radio tab, where a per-radio setting belongs (#474)
- **Config**: an unknown layout or an absurd FFT size in `config.toml` now costs only that one value, instead of the whole file or a hang at start, by @madmedicnl in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/477 (#469)

- The manual covers how the AIS chart and the ADS-B picture decide which vessel names and data blocks to show (#408)
- The manual's PlutoSDR section covers a radio that connects but hears nothing, and how a stalled receive stream is told apart from a board that has paused (#470, #377)
- The manual covers this release's behaviour changes: the step row's First press, the DECODES export and the SWL records an import leaves out, importing files in the browser and its local-storage ceiling, WEFAX PHASE on the chart already received, the AIS chart's zoom, the ten new themes, the JS8 composer, the new SSTV modes, the PureSignal readout, sdr-list.xyz, and the radio's sound card on the Radio tab

## New Contributors

name: v1.6.7
body:
## What's Changed
- **AtCHAT NET**: a new digital chat protocol — modem, virtual channel and NET panel with tabbed chat, file send and adaptive carrier sense by @barisdinc in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/402
- **Antenna memory**: each VFO keeps its own antenna socket across an A/B press inside one band, and hands it back to the band memory when the dial crosses bands by @dielectric-coder in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/424 (#404)
- **AIS**: read each received byte in the right bit order, so ships from real transponders are plotted where they are instead of scattered across the world or missing from the chart — now checked against a published sentence decoded by gpsd (#345, #408)
- **WFM**: the receive filter BW sets the channel filter ahead of the FM detector instead of being ignored (#414)
- **RDS**: the station picture is built only from groups on a confirmed lock, so programme audio on a chance match can no longer invent a station identity
- **Tuning**: a key or wheel step from between two grid points lands on the next one in the direction of travel instead of overshooting by a step (#431)
- **Hamlib rigctld**: read a level reply that arrives as a bare number, so the rig's own S-meter, SWR and power are read at all (#427)
- **Hamlib rigctld**: key CW text through Hamlib's `send_morse`, with keyer speed and stop (#412)
- **Yaesu FTX-1**: play stored CW text with `KY01`, the two-parameter form its CAT manual documents, instead of `KY6` (#412)
- **S-meter**: leave the attached receiver's calibration off the transceiver's audio level in a panadapter pairing (#427)
- **TUNE** in a data mode sends its tone at that mode's transmit-audio level, so ALC can be set with it (#419)
- **CAT**: report a Yaesu `?;` as a refusal, and forget the remembered output power on any refusal so a refused level is written again at the next key-down (#420)
- **CI-V**: take a dial or mode report only from the configured radio, addressed to us or to all, with a well-formed frequency payload and no collision bytes (#415)
- **Xiegu G90**: stop reading the power-output meter, whose reply is not on Icom's scale and showed full power at 10% drive (#430)
- **CAT/Audio**: give back the serial port and sound devices before a runtime interface switch opens the replacement (#15)
- **HL2 I/O board**: send it the transverter's on-air transmit and receive frequencies instead of the I.F. (#292)
- **HL2 I/O board**: once J9 is in use, its receive inputs appear on the ANT control and are kept per band, switched live (#292)
- **PlutoSDR**: offer only the antenna ports the board accepts, trying each once at open, and never the TX monitor loopbacks (#314)
- **PlutoSDR**: grey out the main-window gain slider while the AD9361's own AGC holds the gain, and say how to take it back (#417)
- **Spots**: DX cluster, POTA, SOTA and PSK Reporter spots now reach every local radio tab, not only the station radio's (#410)
- **DX cluster**: say when a node is connected but there is no callsign to log in with, instead of sitting silently at its prompt (#410)
- **Remote client**: drop tunes queued before the station's state arrives, so connecting no longer retunes a radio others are using to the client's defaults (#405)
- **Logbook**: a new hand-entered contact goes to the auto-upload logbooks too, as a sequencer-logged one already did (#428)
- **ANC**: left off, and its chip hidden, in AM, SAM, WFM and DRM, where it cancelled the programme audio (#434)
- **Sliders**: the value readout keeps its widest width, so a value gaining a digit mid-drag no longer moves the rail under the pointer (#429)
- **UI**: the ctrl+plus / ctrl+minus zoom is remembered across restarts (#425)
- **CTR**: keep the dial centred by default on a new station; saved views keep their setting (#422, #411)

## Documentation

- QO-100 quick-start guide in English and Turkish, with rendered PDFs and its diagrams drawn from source by @barisdinc in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/407
- An AtCHAT NET chapter in the user manual (#402)
- The manual covers this release's behaviour changes: the WFM channel filter, the direction-aware tuning step, ANC on broadcast audio, spots on every radio tab, the AIS fix, the G90 meter, Pluto ports and gain, HL2 I/O board inputs per band, CW text keying on the FTX-1 and through rigctld, and CTR on by default


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/compare/v1.6.6...v1.6.7

name: v1.6.6
body:
## What's Changed
- **SpyServer**: follow the dial with the FFT window instead of the server's start-up frequency by @drfruct in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/370
- **I/Q recording**: Fix the recorded auxi chunk's StopTime and its real 164-byte shape by @thereisnocat in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/386
- **I/Q recording** elapsed-time caption no longer rolling its minute early by @thereisnocat in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/387
- **11 m band** on the band bar — CB channel grid, digimode calling channels, and a transmit lockout that knows it is not an amateur allocation (#396)
- **CW message buttons** — up to ten rows of your own text, sent whole on a click or F1–F9 and carried with the station's configuration (#374)
- **CW accented letters** from ITU-R M.1677-1, sent and copied, with the panel picking a decoder that can (#382)
- **Waterfall**: floor and ceiling sliders, an option to draw bins and rows unsmoothed, and the classic SDR#/SDR++ blue palette (#375)
- **Mobile**: a full-width step-down / step / step-up row under the touch control strip (#380)
- **Receive filter**: a BW chip with typeable width, edges and the mode's presets (#371)
- **CAT**: an RS-HFIQ profile with oscillator, transmit switch, I/Q, baud rate and PTT method filled in (#383)
- **HPSDR**: an optional loop that winds LNA gain back while the board reports ADC overflow, plus the board's overflow flag on the S-meter (#362)
- **SmartSDR**: an I/Q swap for a mirrored FLEX stream, and a measured-vs-declared IQ rate in the session trace (#368)
- **JS8**: speed buttons in slowest-to-fastest order with MULTI set apart, all four lit while MULTI decodes, and the speed a message arrived on shown in the list (#389)
- **JS8**: the station a message was addressed to is named in the heard list and the conversation (#372)
- **SSTV**: a Restart RX control, so a misread header no longer costs every picture until it runs out (#397)
- **Squelch**: the dBFS threshold reaches full scale and reports what the passband is reading (#394)
- **SpyServer**: the Airspy HF+'s 8-bit digital gain is now a closed loop on the arriving peak instead of an open-loop constant (#390)
- **S-meter**: a hover that says what the reading is — ALC in per cent of full scale, and that a self-modulating SDR has no SWR bridge to read (#373)
- **Panadapter pairing**: in CW, the transceiver's VFO goes on the contact with a sidetone above the dial (#364)
- **Transmit drive by band**: the applied trim appears in the log and Drive's hover names the band's calibration (#376)
- **Receiver menu**: recording rows are inlined like the filter and NR pickers, so REC works on a narrow window (#388)
- **PlutoSDR**: count the bytes of a payload read, so a board pausing mid-transfer under its own load is waited out instead of costing a socket and buffer reopen (#288)
- **PlutoSDR**: replace a wedged control socket in place instead of tearing the whole radio down, and stop the payload-deadline log announcing a wait it will never take (#377)
- **AIS**: refuse a report from a number that is not a maritime identity, so a repeating slot collision stops becoming a base station in the Pacific (#400)
- **APRS**: a band the mode has no channel in is an ordinary band change, not a jump to FT8's dial in FM packet (#260)
- **WSPR**: the saved hop-band mask is keyed on declaration order, so adding 11 m does not rearrange an existing hop cycle (#396)
- **FT8**: a period that arrives empty is reported as no audio at all, said once instead of every period (#393)
- **Digital modes**: stop reporting the period a mode was selected in as a lost one, and stop warning about microphone glitches that cost no decode (#363, #367)
- **SDRplay**: resolve the configured serial to the receiver it names before sharing a session, so a second radio joins an open RSPduo (#392)
- **HPSDR**: stop the board's stream before starting it and repeat the run command while nothing arrives, so a board left running by another host is reclaimed (#365)
- **PSK Reporter**: report a QO-100 station on its real 10.489 GHz, not the 4.295 GHz the collector's 4-byte frequency field clips it to (#378)
- **SpyServer**: divide float32 samples by the header's digital gain rather than multiplying, which applied the gain twice
- Fix `iq_slack_hz` being measured against the wrong reference
- Fix udev rules

## Documentation

- The Fishball/PlutoSky tezuka build runs a DATV stack a receive-only station can shut down, and why `/etc/init.d` edits do not survive a reboot (#379)
- Say plainly which gain rail the HPSDR overload loop moves: the main window's, not the settings slider (#362)


## New Contributors
* @drfruct made their first contribution in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/370

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/compare/v1.6.5...v1.6.6

name: v1.6.5
body:
## What's changed:

* Fixed incorrect TX timing in FT8 mode for LAN Icom radios, fixes #359
* Added WSS support for websocket, fixes #360
* Clicking on a signal in RTTY mode now always centers on the RTTY pair, not the base frequency
* Added a MULTI chip to JS8 that decodes all four speeds at once, each on its own slot clock, so a station on another speed is heard rather than invisible and an exchange between two speeds can happen at all. fixes #358
* Uploaded JS8 receptions to PSK Reporter: a JS8 decode is one frame of a message and names nobody, so the report now goes out once per reassembled message, when there is a callsign to send. fixes #357
* Added EXPORT and IMPORT buttons for a station's whole settings on Settings → General, so a second machine or a second callsign is one file rather than a folder of screenshots — the logbook and any saved server password deliberately stay behind. fixes #356
* Paced the transceiver's audio by the wall clock instead of assuming the attached receiver hands back a block every 25 ms: on a 2 Msps SDR it is every few, so every draw over-asked and came back mostly silence — continuous stutter. Its capture stream now gets the same generous period the I/Q path has. fixes #354
* Retried a HackRF control change the radio refuses instead of dropping it, and said so when it keeps refusing: the engine is told a tune succeeded the moment it is posted to the stream thread, so a lost one left the dial and the panadapter labelling a frequency the radio was never on, with nothing short of a restart to put it right (#352)
* Covered the gap between asking a rig for PTT and it being on the air before starting an SSTV picture: the leader and VIS code went out into it, and a decoder that misses that header draws no picture at all. fixes #351
* Granted udev access by group as well as by seat ACL: uaccess hands out nothing under WSL2, over ssh, in a container or to a systemd service, which left an AirspyHF+ root-owned with nothing on screen explaining why. fixes #350
* Stopped telling HackRF owners to find a SuperSpeed port: every board ever built is High-Speed USB 2.0 and 20 Msps is what that link is rated for, so the notice now fires only when a board enumerates below high speed, which is a cable or hub fault. fixes #349
* Carried the report when answering a non-standard callsign: the layout that spells out R7KJG/QRP has room for nothing but a bare acknowledgement, so a report or a grid now goes out as an ordinary message with that callsign hashed, the way WSJT-X sends it. fixes #348
* Answered a callsign typed into the public-SDR filter with the receiver named after it: fuzzy matching alone made a six-character callsign a scattered subsequence of a dozen unrelated station names, so the literal matches now win outright and the fuzzy list is what is left when there are none. fixes #347
* Let the FT8 controller say how many periods the decode worker still owes it, so a test waits on that instead of on decodes arriving — a slot that decodes to nothing produces no action at all, which made the wait either stall on quiet slots or expire under load on busy ones
* Gave the mock rig the transmit path it declares: a source with tx_channels and no tx_write is one the engine rightly reports as a lost link, and the test was racing its own shutdown about one run in three
* Let the CW decoder say how much work it has left, so a test waits for it to finish rather than for its output to stop moving for a second — a window a loaded machine loses, which is what returned half a transmission
* Measured the transmit turnaround in receive blocks rather than fixes milliseconds: a 300 ms over against a 341 ms block was one the engine spent entirely inside read, so the audio-mode rows were holes and the assertion failed on an engine doing nothing wrong
* Spelled VDL2's digit out like every other number the voice says, so the mode name reaches the phonemizer as something it can pronounce
* Added World Radio League as a logbook upload target, driven from its published developer API, and a second logging broadcast that speaks N1MM's contactinfo XML beside the WSJT-X one; fixes #337
* Told an RX-888 Mk1 apart from a receiver the firmware could not identify, so it is named rather than reported as a failed detection, stops having its firmware reloaded for nothing, and is told plainly that it streams and has no Mk2 front end to drive; fixes #342
* Broadcast a hand-entered contact to the WSJT-X UDP listeners the way the sequencer's own are, and sent the ADIF datagram as the bare record the protocol defines rather than a whole file export, so a local logger sees the SSB and CW too; fixes #341
* Stopped a glitching audio device from burying the log in identical warnings, said what a glitch actually costs and where it comes from, and let the FT8 panel report the receive period that arrived short so a run of them stops being a silent no-decode; fixes #343, fixes #338
* Wrote an Icom's antenna socket in the form that radio's own reply said it takes, so a receiver with no receiving-antenna relay stops NAKing the change and an IC-R8600's selector actually moves; fixes #334
* Followed the band bar's new top end and the meter's new field through the tests that spell both out; refs #326, #333
* Read the Hermes-Lite 2's board temperature off the status frames this decoder used to skip, and put it in the corner of the S-meter so an HL2 warming up over an afternoon of FT8 shows it; fixes #333
* Added the 3 cm band, so an IC-905 with Icom's own 10 GHz unit inside it can be put on 10368 MHz from the band bar rather than through a transverter table that cannot describe a transverter the radio contains; fixes #326
* Made a memory mark on the waterfall a control as well as a label: clicking one recalls that channel whole, so a stored frequency can be reached where it is being looked at; fixes #320
* Let Ctrl held during a filter-edge drag move that edge alone, so an AM listener can close the passband on the side a neighbour is splattering into without losing the other; fixes #335
* Kept the CW sidetone pitch out of the per-band transmit-offset memory, so a trip through PSK no longer leaves the keyer a kilohertz outside the passband being copied — and gave the pitch its own home on disk; fixes #336
* Dimmed a satellite's name in the 3D view when the Earth is standing in the line of sight, so a still frame says which side of the globe the bird is on; fixes #332
* Stopped the AIS vessel list filling with stations that were never really there: held a frame to the length its message type defines instead of reading its fields out of bits that never arrived, refused an MMSI too large to be one, and let a message this crate cannot interpret confirm a known station without inventing a new one; the chart now says it is waiting for a position rather than looking broken; fixes #330
* Settled a Pluto's tuning range by asking its synthesiser to go there, so a board carrying the frequency-expansion modification gets the 70 MHz-6 GHz it was modified for instead of the stock range its EEPROM still claims; fixes #340
* Stopped a PlutoSDR that answers "nothing yet" instantly from spinning a core flat out, and let a receive link that stalls under load finish its payload instead of losing the socket over it; fixes #328

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/compare/v1.6.4...v1.6.5

body: ## What's changed: * AIS decoder and map * QO-100 beacon plugin: spectral tracker + auto-correct, opt-in AO-40 decode by @barisdinc in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/291 * Refer the SDRplay S-meter to the antenna, and wire up the RSP gain controls the API has by @dielectric-coder in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/299 * AO-40 frame decoder * Added missing CESSB controls to desktop layout (#294) * fixed band selection not working sporadically (#297) * Per-band TX drive calibration (#295) * User configurable open-collector control words per band (#296) * Stop switching an Icom's receiving antenna out of circuit on every band change, give it a control of its own instead of an ANT1/ANT2 chip a one-socket radio has no second socket for, and name sdroxide's own switch LINK so on/off means the radio's; refs #229 * Give the band-change tests a scratch config directory of their own: they were persisting a WSJT-X broadcast into the operator's real config and reading it back on the next run * Say what a refused TCI port means — the SDR software serves TCI, not the radio, and on an MB1 that software runs inside the set; refs #300 * Give the receive path a per-radio gain trim so a transceiver whose USB codec is quiet can be made loud, the AF rail's top being unity; fixes #315 * Keep a night of WSPR receptions rather than two hours, virtualise the list that holds them, and colour each map dot by the band it was heard on; fixes #316 * Stand the Pluto's receive buffer down for the length of an antenna change, so rf_port_select is not refused and the ANT button actually moves the socket; fixes #314 * Cover every 25 kHz VDL2 channel including 136.900, measure each one in its own bandwidth so a neighbouring station cannot open its gate, and add a HOLD for the message log; refs #265 * Add new Command::TuneWidebandTo() to fix #310 * Put the rig in its data mode for SSTV, on whichever sideband the band calls for, and make DIGU/DIGL set an Icom's DATA switch at all; fixes #313 * Fix ISM decode issue #310 * Add a setting to leave the cities off the flat maps, so a panel of FT8 contacts is not read through a field of named grey dots; closes #312 * Put a 2R2T Pluto's second receive chain into the gain-control mode its radio asked for, so the second receiver's gain slider reaches the hardware; fixes #311 * Make RADE use LSB on the longer bands, fixes #317 * Measure the two capture channels about their own means so a card's DC offset is not read as one signal on both, hold the tap's level to the six seconds its doc claims, and say plainly that the panadapter removed check is belt and braces; refs #308 #307 #309 * Let the KiwiSDR band view be a real waterfall of a few hundred kilohertz instead of only the whole 0-30 MHz, following the dial; closes #303 * Feed the FT8/FT4/FT2 decoder linear audio instead of the AGC's, and look at every candidate a busy band produces; fixes #307 * Stop a finer panadapter also being a slower one: zero-pad the transform so FT8/FT4/FT2 waterfalls show a third of a second a row instead of five; fixes #302 * Take up the panadapter a FlexRadio kept for us rather than asking for another every session, and borrow one when the radio has none left; fixes #309 * Stop one impossible sample leaving the AGC deaf for the rest of the session, and say when the chain produces one; fixes #305 * Say when a card declared as I/Q is carrying the same signal on both channels, which draws every signal twice and no correction can undo; fixes #308 * Fix band changes being reverted by the UI (fixes #298) * Count the Airspy, HydraSDR, Fobos, SpyServer and KiwiSDR gains in steps too, the main Gain slider having called every one of them decibels * Put the SDRplay IF constants back beside their own doc comments, IF_0_450 having taken IF_1_620's * Bring the manual up to what the SDRplay backend now does with gain, the AGC set point, HDR and the S-meter * Stop the SDRplay LNA sliders trimming a stored state to whatever band the radio happens to be on * Keep the transmit gain stages when a front end revises its receive ladder * Say when capabilities are a revision of the same front end, so a band edge no longer reads to a client as a new radio * Clamp the AGC set point to the range the rate and the gain floor allow on the live path too, not only at open * Send the RSPdx's HDR filter at open, so a stored choice is not silently replaced by the API's default * Tell the manual about QRG, which had it stating flatly that the big readout is always the dial * Give cw_pitch_hz its own doc comment back, instead of the one it took from on_air_freq_hz * Let CW read the frequency of the signal rather than of the dial, so the number in the readout is the one both operators would quote ## New Contributors * @dielectric-coder made their first contribution in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/299 **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/compare/v1.6.3...v1.6.4

name: v1.6.3
body:
## What's Changed

* Add RigExpert FobosSDR support by @thereisnocat in https://github.com/dividebysandwich/sdroxide/pull/274 - Thanks a lot!
* Added controlled-envelope SSB (implements #283)
* PureSignal support for HPSDR (implements #283)
* Each VFO now has its own mode and filter memory (implements #286)
* Operators can now save their own frequencies into each digital mode's frequency picker (implements #268)
* Implement relay control (implements #227)
* Implement binaural mode for SSB and CW (implements #263) - Reachable via the BIN button on the top UI.
* Add ISB reception: both sidebands demodulated, one to each ear; closes #280
